generate_fake_structures: generate fake atomic structures with LJ-like energies and repulsive forces from a FakeDatasetConfig
create_fake_dataset: create a single fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig and write it to disk
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: generate all 5 UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes into a temp directory
configure_fake_dataset: configure a FakeDatasetConfig with name, system size range, energy std, and forces std parameters
compute_lj_energy: compute the Lennard-Jones potential energy for an ASE Atoms object with configurable epsilon and sigma
